title: cymbopogon traninhensis
intro: Cymbopogon traninhensis, commonly known as Traninh grass, is a species of grass in the family Poaceae. This plant is valued for its essential oil, which has been traditionally used in Vietnamese medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Cymbopogon traninhensis include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation, prevent infections, and protect against cell damage. The plant's bioactive constituents include sesquiterpenes, such as cis- and trans-caryophyllene, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects.
